summary: Backend regression manual_start_production_qr.py and manual_run_wizard.py both PASS end-to-end. Frontend Factory Staff CRUD (production_operator checkbox + operator-badge, pre-checked on edit, PIN set via API), Production Batches 'Start Production QR' dialog (QR image, tenant URL, operator-count '1 production operator enabled', print pop-up), and the full staff Face/PIN sign-in journey on /start-production/nyla-air-water all work: roster excludes 'ZZ QR Plain', PIN sign-in for 'ZZ QR Operator' logs in and shows the actor chip, the SKU form initiates a batch, /production-run/<id> wizard renders with back link 'Start Production', Start → crates 10 → Stop → Create Production Batch navigates to /start-production/nyla-air-water?done=<code> with the success banner. 'Runs in progress' shows a Resume button that opens the wizard, and Cancel run (confirm accepted) returns to the start page. HOWEVER: two related bugs found in the frontend authentication key used by the Start-Production flow — the flow reads `localStorage.session_token`, but the app stores the app-user JWT under `token` (see AuthContext line 159 `localStorage.setItem('token', session_token)`). As a result: (a) a logged-in CEO opening /start-production/nyla-air-water is INCORRECTLY shown the Factory Staff sign-in screen instead of going straight to the SKU form (staff-mode is forced on for every app user); (b) the wizard's `staffMode()` also always evaluates to true for an app user, which changes the back link/post-close navigation for app users; (c) StartProductionQrDialog builds `Authorization: Bearer null` for its raw fetch — the sticker endpoint still returns 200 (it accepts tenant-only auth), but the code path is wrong. Also, the negative 'flag-removed → error card' check was inconclusive in the browser because the HttpOnly admin session cookie from an earlier login is auto-attached same-origin, letting the request satisfy `get_user_or_factory_staff` as the app user before the staff-token path runs — the backend gate itself works correctly (manual_start_production_qr.py verifies 403 after flag removal).

integration_issues.issue: CEO/app user opening /start-production/nyla-air-water is shown Factory Staff sign-in instead of the SKU form. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/lib/staffSession.js scanAuthHeaders() reads localStorage.getItem('session_token') but the actual token key set by AuthContext is 'token'. StartProductionScan.js line 26 then short-circuits to needLogin because no Authorization header is produced.

ProductionRunWizard.js line 15 `staffMode() = !localStorage.getItem('session_token') && !!getStaffSession()` uses the wrong token key. For an app user with a staff session, staffMode() unexpectedly returns true; for an app user without a staff session it returns false (works by accident). Fix: use 'token' or import a shared session key.

StartProductionQrDialog.js line 8 builds `Authorization: Bearer null` because it reads 'session_token'. The sticker endpoint currently accepts it (tenant header suffices) so the QR still renders, but the Authorization header is malformed. Same wrong key is used in InitiateBatchDialog.js, PerRunMaintenanceFields.js, ProductionRunPanel.js, QualityParamsDialog.js, MaintenancePhotoGallery.js, MaintenanceProfile.js, EquipmentInstructions.js, AlertDigestCard.js — most of these work only because a global axios interceptor auto-attaches the 'token' bearer for axios calls, but raw fetch()/direct axios calls that spread `H()` override the interceptor with `Bearer null`.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/lib/staffSession.js — scanAuthHeaders() should read localStorage.getItem('token') (or the same key as AuthContext) instead of 'session_token'.
Fix ProductionRunWizard.js staffMode() to use the correct token key (or import from staffSession).

Grep for `localStorage.getItem('session_token')` across /app/frontend/src — replace with `token` (11+ files affected). Regression: production run wizard actions, start-production QR dialog, per-run maintenance, maintenance profile, alert digest, quality params dialog, initiate batch dialog, equipment instructions.

After the fix, re-verify: (1) app-user opens /start-production/:tenantId → SKU form direct with actor chip 'Signed in as app user'; (2) authorization headers on raw fetch calls carry a real bearer token.
critical_code_review_comments: Widespread use of a non-existent localStorage key `session_token` (11+ frontend files). This is a latent bug that only appears when the caller uses raw fetch or spreads the header object directly (bypassing the axios interceptor).

StartProductionScan.js:26 gates on presence of Authorization/X-Staff-Token in the header object; it should also attempt the API and rely on the 401 branch for consistency (defense-in-depth) — otherwise a header-key rename immediately breaks the app-user path.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After the token-key fix, verify (a) CEO opening /start-production/nyla-air-water lands on start-production-form with actor chip mentioning 'app user', and (b) the flag-removed → error case in a fresh incognito browser (no admin cookies). Backend gate is correct (see manual_start_production_qr.py).
rca of the issue: AuthContext.js writes the JWT under localStorage key 'token', but /app/frontend/src/lib/staffSession.js scanAuthHeaders() and ProductionRunWizard.js staffMode() (plus many raw-fetch call sites) read a legacy key 'session_token' that is never set. Consequence: for app users, scanAuthHeaders returns no Authorization → StartProductionScan.js flips to needLogin regardless of app login. Repro: (1) login as CEO, (2) visit /start-production/nyla-air-water — observe Factory Staff Sign-in card instead of SKU form. Mitigation: rename to 'token' or extract a shared helper `getAppToken()` from AuthContext.
